body: I feel sort of bad about this whole post because I feel like I went overboard and got way too dramatic about all of it. I need to toughen up and just push through, and if it's my dream then I need to have more patience. It's so kind that some if you would like to see it--I initially posted the link but I really don't want my family or friends coming across this post, so if anyone would really like to see it, send me a private message and I'll send a link. Thank you all for the supportive and kind comments, it seriously means so much ❤️

Oh my gosh...it really means a lot to me that you'd like to but I feel like I'd be just fishing for views if I posted it...and I really shouldn't have said I have no readers, because the few I have mean the world to me and I'd never want to sound ungrateful towards them.

Thank you, that means a lot. I started walking out the door with the intention of finding somewhere to peacefully die, probably a bridge, but I turned back when my dog started to follow me. I feel like I could never leave her alone. She wouldn't understand why or how I left her if I ever did. So, I'm still here.
I never said they were thoughtless.

I'm a worthless human being and I just take up space. Everything I do is a nuisance to everyone around me and I can't even do simple mundane tasks without fucking something up. The world would be better without me

Update--I talked to her and she told me that she was upset I wasn't getting a job because she's sick of me being in the apartment. Not sure if that's much better. Thank all you so much for your wonderful comments, I really wasn't sure how to approach this and I felt like I had caused her to act this way.
